# `assets/render/ModelGpu.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/render/ModelGpu.js`

engine/assets/render/ModelGpu.js — reusable GPU-side helpers to turn an uploaded EngineModel into drawable items. Small, composable, and shared by the importer/viewer, the editor, and the runtime so nobody re-implements texture upload, per-primitive bind groups, world-matrix flattening, or bounds framing.  Pairs with ModelShader (uniform block) and GpuUploader (vertex layout). Pure data in → GPU objects out; callers own the render pass and camera.

## Functions

### `createDefaultSampler(device)`

A linear, repeating sampler — a sane default for model albedo.

### `createWhiteTexture(device)`

A 1×1 white texture so untextured primitives sample white (albedo = color).

### `makeGpuTexture(device, bitmap, srgb)`

Upload one decoded bitmap to a GPU texture (sRGB for colour, linear for data).

### `async uploadModelTextures(device, model)`

Decode + upload every embedded texture in a model.

**Returns:** >}

### `primitiveColor(model, prim)`

Deterministic fallback colour for a primitive lacking a baseColorFactor.

### `buildModelDrawables(device, model, opts)`

Build drawable items for an uploaded model: one per primitive, each with its world draw matrix, uniform buffer, bind group, fallback colour, and (optional) wheel-spin descriptor keyed by node id.

**Returns:** >}

### `bakeSkinnedMeshes(model)`

CPU-skin every skinned mesh to its DEFAULT pose so the static viewer draws the mesh wrapped around the node-hierarchy skeleton (per the glTF rule that a skinned mesh's own node transform is ignored). For each skinned vertex: v' = Σ wⱼ · (jointNodeWorld(j) · inverseBindMatrix(j)) · v   (scene space) Positions/normals are replaced in place (original kept on `_bindPosition`) and the primitive is flagged `_skinnedBaked`. No-op without skins/IBMs. GPU-free.

**Returns:** primitives baked

### `releaseDrawables(items)`

Free per-item uniform buffers built by buildModelDrawables.

### `frameBounds(items)`

World-space bounds of a set of drawables, for camera framing.

**Returns:** |null}

### `importMatrixOf(model)`

Compose the standard import-correction matrix from a model's importTransform.

`nodeLocalMatrix`
